The dispatcher stops re-dispatching a unit after a producer_failed landing until its command/script changes. research_slo producer_failed_rate_24h reads ok (<=0.25) on two consecutive passes.

what: Research SLO producer_failed_rate_24h breached at 2026-11-03T21:23:55Z: 0.305 vs <=0.25 (open breaches now 3 of 19). MEASURED over research/results/*/*.jsonl rows with generated_at >= 2026-11-02T21:30Z: 47 producer_failed rows. Dominant cause: 'no verdict.json. The script ran but did not grade its own output against RULE-...', on RULE-P5-MLDIAG-MINEDGE, RULE-P5-MLV-GATE-MOVINGTP, RULE-P5-MLDIAG-RISKCURVE, RULE-P5-MLDIAG-DECOMP and RULE-P5-SX-GATE-{SOL,ETH}-{P,SW15,SW15R1}. The units' scripts do not emit verdict.json, so this is an authoring/harness contract defect, not compute. Minor causes: 'no run-manifest.json' (e.g. RQ-20261025-3947-05 via research-script-run-kaggle-cpu run 41531253672) and cmd exit=1 (RQ-20261031-7b6f-13).
